title: Ending a TRICARE Reserve Select Plan at the Purchaser's Request: the Reserve Select Closing Reconciliation
content:
**TRICARE Premium-Based Plans - TRICARE Reserve Select.**

## The rule

When the purchaser of a TRICARE Reserve Select plan confirms in person the ending of the plan they asked for, the plan books with that confirmation its Reserve Select closing reconciliation: one termination-by-request credit, posted against the monthly bill of the latest-billed coverage month, for the premium billed for days of the closing period that the plan no longer charges for and that no credit has yet returned or relieved. For a TRICARE Reserve Select plan, the purchaser ends the plan only by confirming in person a request the agent recorded as an intake, and the Reserve Select closing reconciliation is the consequence of that confirmation and is booked by it, not recorded afterwards as a separate agent service action. The paid-bill condition for credits is set aside only for a Reserve Select closing reconciliation, which is posted against that monthly bill although no payment stands against it; every other credit on the plan still needs a payment posted against its bill. For a TRICARE Reserve Select plan ended at the purchaser's confirmed request, the Reserve Select closing reconciliation takes the place of the termination credit for the bills of the closing period; an ending for loss of eligibility or the purchaser's death, and every plan of another kind, keeps the termination credit. The Reserve Select closing reconciliation is figured only after the monthly bill of the most recently paid month carries the early-duty month credit owed for its days of active duty coverage. The Reserve Select closing reconciliation is not figured before the coverage-type adjustment billed for the most recently paid month carries the family-adjustment relief owed for its days of active duty coverage. The Reserve Select closing reconciliation is figured only after the coverage-type adjustment billed for a later latest-billed month carries the later-month family relief owed for its days of active duty coverage.

## Purchaser's confirmation: `confirm_reserve_select_ending_f251f30d`

**Capability.** The purchaser of a TRICARE Reserve Select plan confirms in person the ending of the plan they asked for. The confirmation marks the purchaser's pending request to end the plan as confirmed and ends the plan (status terminated by request) on the termination date given. As the consequence of that confirmation, the plan books its closing reconciliation: one termination-by-request credit tied to the named bill and coverage month, for the amount stated, which lowers the plan's premium balance by that amount.

**How it is invoked.** `confirm_reserve_select_ending_f251f30d` is the purchaser's own action. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves - the purchaser - runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `premium_request_id` | reference number of the purchaser's pending request to end the plan, as the representative reads it out from the plan's request record | identifier |
| `premium_enrollment_id` | reference number of the premium-based plan being ended, as the representative reads it out from the purchaser's plan record | identifier |
| `termination_date` | the last day of coverage, exactly as the representative reads it out | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `related_premium_entry_id` | reference number of the monthly bill the closing reconciliation is posted against, as the representative reads it out from the premium ledger | identifier |
| `coverage_month` | coverage month of that bill, exactly as the bill shows it | YYYY-MM |
| `coverage_days` | number of days of that month the closing reconciliation counts, exactly as the representative reads it out | integer from 1 to 31 |
| `amount` | the closing reconciliation in USD, already rounded to the cent, exactly as the representative states it | positive number with 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `premium_request_id` (the request confirmed), `request_outcome` (always confirmed), `premium_enrollment_id` (the plan ended), `plan_status` (always `terminated_by_request`), `termination_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `premium_entry_id` (reference number of the new credit entry), `related_premium_entry_id` (the bill credited), `coverage_month` (YYYY-MM), `coverage_days` (integer), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `adjustment_reason` (always `termination_by_request`) and `premium_balance_due` (the plan's premium balance in USD after the credit; a negative figure means money is owed to the purchaser).
